name: Hierarchical Block Significance Map with Offset Arrays
aliases: Slice Info / Block 32 Info / Block 8 Info structure
definition: A hierarchical data structure for storing significant wavelet coefficients and their significance maps, designed for fast random access. It splits slices into quadratic blocks of size B=32, then into sub-blocks of size 8, then into lines, using bitmaps and offset arrays to locate data in streams without variable-length decoding overhead.
